in_english.name: Mutahhar
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mutahhar means purity, innocence, goodness, nobility, and elevation. It is derived from the Arabic root t-h-r, which carries the meaning of purification, cleansing, and sanctification. In Islamic tradition, the name Mutahhar is associated with the concept of tazkiyah, or spiritual purification, which involves the cleansing of the heart and soul from sin and corruption. The name is also associated with the concept of rida, or divine pleasure, which is the state of being in a state of spiritual elevation and closeness to Allah.
